responsibility: Provides the shared Sphinx build configuration for GNAT Ada manuals, acting as the entry-point configuration script that selects which document set to build from DOC_NAME, derives version and build-type information from gnatvsn.ads and BASE-VER, configures extensions, exclusion lists, numbering, HTML/LaTeX/Texinfo metadata, and assembles LaTeX settings from the companion latex_elements module. It also registers the custom Ada and GPR lexers, sets build tags for PRO/FSF/GPL variants, and controls document-specific assets and output parameters for the generated manuals.
